Architecture
Everything in one plugin.
Seven powerful modules designed to work together while remaining independently configurable.
🛡️

Anti-Cheat

50 detection checks including ML anomaly detection, packet fingerprinting, behavioral profiling, violation escalation, threat scoring, lockout system and TPS-adaptive protection.

  • KillAura, AimAssist, ImpossibleHit, GhostHand
  • Movement, NoFall, Phase, Step, Spider
  • Timer, Blink, Rotation, FastPlace, Scaffold
  • Jesus, Criticals, BowSpam, Xray, FastHeal
  • NoKnockback, AntiHunger, NoSlow
  • BadSessions, PacketFingerprint, BehaviorProfile
  • MccAnalyze, MlDetect — ML anomaly detection
  • Player lockout on critical flags
  • Aggressive escalation (alert→kick→ban)
  • Composite threat score 0–100
  • TPS-adaptive sensitivity
👁️

Anti-ESP

Protects hidden information and reduces unfair client-side visibility advantages.

  • Block obfuscation
  • Player visibility manager
  • View distance optimization
  • Anti-free-cam detection
  • Paper Anti-Xray advisory
⚡

Optimization

TPS-aware server optimization designed to reduce unnecessary entity and redstone load.

  • Entity sweep & merge
  • Mob cap enforcement
  • Hopper throttling
  • Redstone throttling
  • Join ramp optimizer
  • Chunk health reporter
🔐

Verification

Join-limbo protection designed to slow down automated bots before they reach the server.

  • Move verification
  • Click-block verification
  • IP rate limiting
  • Void limbo generator
  • Automatic verification flow
🎬

Replay

Rolling movement buffers allow staff to review suspicious gameplay after a violation.

  • Automatic flag recording
  • Staff playback manager
  • Snapshots & clips
  • Per-player clip history
🔬

Anti Reverse-Engineering

Protects the plugin's bytecode from decompilation and tampering. Detects JVM debuggers, class modifications at runtime, and external plugins reflecting into internal packages.

  • JVM debugger / profiler detection
  • Class bytecode hash verification
  • External plugin reflection scan
  • Lockdown mode on tampering
  • Disables anti-cheat if modified
  • Staff alerts on RE attempts
🚨

Anti-DDoS

Application-layer DDoS protection for self-hosted servers without a proxy or CDN. Enforces global and per-IP connection rate limits with auto-blacklisting.

  • Global login rate limiting
  • Per-IP connection caps
  • Auto-blacklist flooding IPs
  • Emergency lockdown mode
  • IP whitelist for trusted networks
  • Concurrent connection limiting
Detection Engine
50 Anti-Cheat Checks.
Search, filter and inspect every detection module. Each check uses TPS compensation and Geyser exemptions where applicable.
